body: Fourth garage interlude, x01/x02/x03 convention. Dramatizes the house rule from the founder's own commissioning quote, grounded in REDGARDEN's real kit table (arena_ai_bridge.c): Tree's W is literally named UNTRANSLATED (no-op passive), R is GRAND SECRET (bigger-sounding, structurally unusable) -- matching the established 'speaks French, never subtitled' bit exactly. Frog's kit (LOOP BACK, BORROWED TIME, THE SECRET) is functionally interactive by comparison. No new hero/code -- pure episode-writing grounded in existing shipped mechanics, same discipline as x03's Mid-Piano receipt. Published https://okemily.com/blog/ask-the-frog-not-the-tree/ (author EINHORN_MEDIA).
title: Series X x04 -- 'Ask the Frog (Not the Tree)'
